5528.title: Installer launch failure does not cancel native quit
5528.rootCauseOneLine: Real NSIS launch rejection does not cancel BaseUpdater scheduled quit; bb accepts the native event before late launch errors.

prReviews.topFinding: Acceptance event is not successful process launch and cannot cancel scheduled quit.

5528.proposedFix: Validate a Windows process-launch acceptance boundary before committing to application shutdown; cover normal, elevated, fallback, failure and retry lifecycles.
5528.caveats: Linux process-boundary fault injection only. Native Windows outage, durable failed result and Retry were not exercised. No safe simple fix PR.
